_about: Editorial layer for /guides/best-resume-tools. Numbers never live here: ratings, prices and scores come from lib/scorecards/resume-tools.json, other reviewers from benchmarks.json, videos from videos.json. call.stance: agrees (we land where current lists land) | breaks (we land somewhere else, and say why) | thin (not enough evidence for anyone to rank it). call lines are drafts until the founder marks them up (callsReviewed). yearCost is the cheapest published way to pay for 12 months of the paid plan, computed from the pricing in resume-tools.json; 4-week plans renew 13 times a year. risingPick is the founder's up-and-coming pick; confirmed=false means the tool and line are a draft for her to approve or replace.

refreshLog.what: Ratings, review counts, prices and traffic ranks
Other reviewers' lists and demo videos added
refreshLog.how: Gathered from search listings. Confirmed on the live pages at the next monthly check.

picks.label: Top-rated checker
picks.line: Checker, builder, and job tracker in one, with a real free tier.

picks.label: Top-rated builder
picks.line: $96 a year with no surprise renewals, and students get six months free.

risingPick.label: Stephanie's pick
risingPick.line: It hands you a clean, watermark-free PDF for nothing, and the people using it rate it as high as anything in the category.

teal.bestFor: Checker, builder, and tracker in one. Real free tier

call.line: Three current lists name Teal, and we rank it first too.

verdict.bestIf: You want one tool for the whole search: resume builder, per-job keyword matching, and application tracking. The free version is useful, and it rates 4.9 from 3,200 Chrome Web Store ratings.
verdict.skipIf: You only need one deep scan against one job description. Jobscan's per-job reports go further.
verdict.like: The free version lets you download your resume. If you pay, $79 a quarter is the best deal.
verdict.watch: The $13 weekly plan looks cheap but adds up fast. Pay monthly or quarterly instead.

teal.freeAnswer: Yes. The free version lets you build and download your resume. Teal+ is $29 a month or $79 a quarter.

call.line: Three current lists name Jobscan. It ranks third of the checkers we can score here: its users rate it below Teal's and Huntr's, and a year costs $359.80.

jobscan.freeAnswer: Partly. You get 5 free scans a month. Paid plans are $49.95 a month or $89.95 a quarter.

resume-worded.bestFor: Instant free score; the fixes cost $49/mo

call.line: Zapier and SkillScouter (#7) both name it, but with 9 public reviews there isn't enough to rate it, here or anywhere.

resume-worded.freeAnswer: Partly. The score is free; the fixes cost $49 a month or $229 a year.

kickresume.bestFor: Best paid builder. Templates recruiters read

call.line: Zapier, Geekflare and SkillScouter (#5) all name it, and it tops our builders too. $96 a year is the whole price, with no surprise renewals.

verdict.bestIf: You want a polished paid builder without surprise billing: $96 a year, flat, with 6,400 mobile ratings averaging 4.6 to back it up.
verdict.skipIf: FlowCV's free tier already covers you. Pay for a builder only when you need multiple tailored versions.
verdict.like: Free tier allows real downloads on basic templates. Students get six months of premium free with a student ID.
verdict.watch: Web and iOS pricing differ; the App Store subscription is cheaper. Check both before paying.

kickresume.freeAnswer: Yes, with basic templates and real downloads. Premium is $96 a year, $54 a quarter or $24 a month.

flowcv.bestFor: Free builder with no watermark on the PDF

call.line: None of the current lists we've checked names FlowCV. It’s here because of its users: 4.9 from 83 public ratings, and a free plan that gives you a watermark-free PDF.

flowcv.freeAnswer: Yes. The free plan gives you a watermark-free PDF. Pro is $60 a year.

call.line: SkillScouter ranks Rezi sixth, and we rank it third of the builders we can score: ATS-first formatting and a $149 lifetime plan that never renews.

rezi.pricingLine: 1 resume and 3 PDFs free · $29/mo or $149 lifetime
rezi.freeAnswer: Partly: one resume and three PDF downloads. After that it's $29 a month, or $149 once for lifetime access.

resume-io.bestFor: Polished editor behind a billing trap

call.line: Zapier and Geekflare both name Resume.io. We rank it last of the builders we can score: the $2.95 trial renews at $29.95 every 4 weeks, and creators are now posting how-to-cancel videos.

verdict.bestIf: You want the slickest editor in the category, you set a calendar reminder to cancel, and you only need it for a week at $2.95.
verdict.skipIf: You might forget to cancel. The trial renews at $29.95 every 4 weeks, 13 times a year, and the free download is plain text with your formatting stripped.
verdict.watch: The only public reviews we can use average 1.5 out of 5 across 195 Product Hunt reviews, nearly all about the renewals. The App Store apps under this name are third-party lookalikes, not Resume.io.

resume-io.pricingLine: $2.95 7-day trial, renews $29.95 every 4 weeks · free download is .txt only
resume-io.freeAnswer: No. The free download is a .txt file with your formatting stripped. What you get is a $2.95 7-day trial that renews at $29.95 every 4 weeks.

call.line: Geekflare names it, but it has 1 public review, too few to rate. No free plan, and the trial watermarks your download.

enhancv.pricingLine: 7-day watermarked trial · from about $13.33/mo on 6-month billing
enhancv.freeAnswer: No. There's a 7-day trial, and its downloads are watermarked. Plans start around $13.33 a month, billed every 6 months.

call.line: Geekflare names it, but there are no public reviews to rate yet.

novoresume.freeAnswer: Partly: a one-page PDF is free. Premium is $19.99 a month.

call.line: Zety's strongest placements are on lists owned by its own parent company, BOLD. We show those lists and don't count them. On the lists and reviews we do count, it doesn't earn a rank.

zety.pricingLine: $1.95 trial, renews $25.95 every 4 weeks · free download is .txt only
zety.freeAnswer: No. The free download is a .txt file. What you get is a $1.95 14-day trial that renews at $25.95 every 4 weeks.

huntr.bestFor: Job tracker, resume builder and autofill in one. Real free plan

call.line: Geekflare and SkillScouter (#10) both name Huntr, and its users back them: 4.6 from about 1,300 Chrome Web Store ratings, and a free plan that exports a real PDF.

huntr.pricingLine: Free plan with PDF export · Pro $40/mo, $90/quarter or $160 per 6 months
huntr.freeAnswer: Yes. The free plan includes unlimited resumes, PDF export, 2 job-tailored resumes and tracking for up to 100 jobs. Pro is $40 a month, $90 a quarter or $160 every 6 months.

plans._about: Paid plans as published on each pricing page (same source and date as the scorecard pricing). days = how long one payment covers. once = paid once, never renews. trial = only at the start, renews into the next plan. Used by the cost calculator.

scoringNote: freeLevel rule: full = you can download a usable resume PDF free, with no watermark and no tiny cap; limited = usable but capped (scans per month, one page, a few downloads, score only); none = nothing usable without paying (.txt only, watermark, trial only).
